statement: Ava's birthday this year falls on a Friday. Her cousin's birthday this year is exactly $75$ days after Ava's. On what day of the week is her cousin's birthday?

choices.misconception: I found that $75$ leaves remainder $5$ when divided by $7$, but I counted $5$ days backward from Friday instead of forward.
I divided $75$ by $7$ and used the quotient $10$ instead of the remainder, and $10$ days after Friday is a Monday.
I counted Friday itself as day $1$, so I only moved $74$ days ahead, which is $4$ days past Friday.
I found the remainder $5$ but counted $5$ school days, skipping Saturday and Sunday, so I landed on Friday again.

hints: Every $7$ days the day of the week repeats.
Remove as many full weeks from $75$ days as you can. Only the leftover days change the weekday.
$75 = 7 \cdot 10 + 5$, so the birthday is $5$ days after a Friday.

solutions.reliable: Since $75 = 7 \cdot 10 + 5$, going $75$ days ahead is the same as going $10$ full weeks and then $5$ more days. Ten full weeks after a Friday is again a Friday. Five more days: Saturday, Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday. The cousin's birthday is on a Wednesday.
solutions.elegant: $75$ days is $2$ days short of $77 = 11 \cdot 7$ days, which would land on Friday. Two days before Friday is Wednesday.

author: Devansh Sanghavi
